# Mighty Test

> STEM, Robotics & AI examination platform for schools. Teachers create and grade exams; students take assessments online with instant feedback, analytics, and parent visibility.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the Mighty Test platform, features, and subjects.
- [About](/about): Mission, vision, and values behind Mighty Test.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about registration, grading, resits, and security.
- [Contact](/contact): How to reach the Mighty Test team.
- [Sign in / Register](/auth): Student, parent, teacher, and admin authentication.
